body_md:
## Overview

This is a sample post used only to test the drafting workflow. It is not an article, it carries no legal content, and it is never filed on the live site. A real run refuses any slug that starts with the word sample.

The checks in this file mirror the rules the site publishes in its content brief: a word range, required sections, a list of banned phrases, the general disclaimer word for word, a link to the contact page, and a small number of internal links that all exist in the site inventory.

A related page for reference is [the sample practice page](/practice-areas/sample-practice), and a second one is [the other practice page](/practice-areas/other-practice).

## What to do next

When a dry run passes, the next step is for the Blog desk to write a real post from the live brief and push it to a queue branch. The workflow then reads the live brief again, because the site is the authority on its own policy, and refuses the file if it breaks any rule.

Questions about a specific situation belong with a lawyer. To reach the firm, use [the contact page](/contact), which lists the current details.

More background on how the site is organised is on [the county page](/locations/sample-county) and on [the city page](/locations/sample-county/sample-city/sample-practice).

## Frequently asked questions

**Is this a real article?** No. It is a fixture for tests.

**Does a dry run create anything?** No. It reads, checks and reports.

**Can a queue file publish a post?** No. The workflow never sends a publish field, and the key has no publish right.
